title: Stop Sending This Sales Message — Try This Rewrite
audience_problem: A beginner sends vague service pitches and does not know what to change.
packaging_promise: Show a vague message becoming a specific fictional café pitch with one small question.
description:
Before: a vague pitch asking for a call. After: one relevant observation, one specific offer, and one small next step. Watch this fictional café message get repaired.

This is an original BizNex teaching framework, not a proven conversion formula. Examples are illustrative; replies, clients and income are not guaranteed. Contact people respectfully, follow applicable rules, and stop when asked.

General marketing background: https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/

The full Repair Lab episode builds the five-part message checklist.

sources.claim: The rewrite is an original BizNex heuristic using a fictional café, not an experimentally proven result. SBA supplies general marketing-planning background only.

segments.title: The vague pitch
segments.text: Stop sending this: I provide amazing services. Can we jump on a call? What service? Why me?
beat_phrases: Can we jump on a call

segments.title: The useful rewrite
segments.text: Try this fictional café example: Your menu is hard to read on mobile. I made a clearer sample.
beat_phrases: Your menu is hard to read

segments.title: A smaller next step
segments.text: Want me to send it? One relevant observation. One specific deliverable. One small question, not a meeting demand.

segments.title: Repair one sentence
segments.text: No guaranteed replies. Just a clearer message. Repair yours before sending another pitch.
